description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 9007199254740991, the largest safe range (2^53 less 1 is the largest safe integer). The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. The page file is written by hand, so its JSON text literally holds 9007199254740993 (2^53 plus 1), which a JavaScript number cannot hold: JSON.parse reads it as 9007199254740992. The page claims blocks 0 to 9007199254740993 and holds an open at block 9007199254740993. An integer must be safe (clause 14), so the page's to_block is not an integer and the whole census refuses (clause 12), instead of counting an event that lies outside the request. Expected: the census refuses; no totals.
